name: AE2WTLib
description: AE2WTLib 19.5.1 for the AE2 port: the Wireless Universal Terminal and the Wireless Pattern Encoding and Pattern Access Terminals (slice 1), its combine and upgrade recipes (slice 2), the Magnet Card (slice 3), Restock, Pick Block, the hotbar counts and the trash (slice 4), the Quantum Bridge Card (slice 5).
